policy: Only source-linked observations passing structural, geographic, unit, date, and price checks are published. Rejected rows are listed with source URLs and reason codes; regional reports are not assigned to a yard or county. Historical quarantined observations are retained across refreshes until a stable-ID observation passes validation; they are never silently discarded.
